nodes.name: Graph Utilities
nodes.description: Generic graph construction, representation conversion, and node-feature utilities

nodes.name: knn_graph
nodes.description: Build a directed k-nearest-neighbor graph from rows of point or feature coordinates
nodes.type_signature: (features: NDArray[np.float64], k: int, metric: str = "euclidean") -> tuple[NDArray[np.int64], NDArray[np.float64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Building a cKDTree of N features takes O(N log N) time, and querying the k-nearest neighbors for all points requires O(N * (log N + k)) time and O(N * k) space.

nodes.name: radius_graph
nodes.description: Connect all ordered pairs of distinct coordinates within a radius
nodes.type_signature: (coordinates: NDArray[np.float64], radius: float, p: float = 2.0) -> tuple[NDArray[np.int64], NDArray[np.float64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Querying ball points on a KD-tree takes O(N log N) time to construct and find neighbors, plus O(E) to compute and store the E returned edges.

nodes.name: molecular_distance_graph
nodes.description: Build a directed distance-cutoff graph over 3-D atom coordinates
nodes.type_signature: (coordinates: NDArray[np.float64], elements: NDArray[np.str_], cutoff: float) -> tuple[NDArray[np.int64], NDArray[np.float64], NDArray[np.float64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing the pairwise distance matrix for N atoms using cdist requires O(N^2) time and space.

nodes.name: adjacency_to_edge_list
nodes.description: Convert a dense adjacency matrix to coordinate-form edge indices
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Finding nonzero entries in a dense N x N adjacency matrix requires traversing the entire matrix in O(N^2) time, producing an edge list of size E.

nodes.name: edge_list_to_adjacency
nodes.description: Convert coordinate-form edge indices to a dense adjacency count matrix
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Initializing and filling a dense N x N adjacency matrix from E edges requires O(N^2 + E) time and O(N^2) space.

nodes.name: graph_laplacian
nodes.description: Compute an unnormalized or symmetric normalized graph Laplacian
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Computing the dense graph Laplacian matrix of size N x N performs element-wise operations and matrix scaling in O(N^2) time and space.

nodes.name: node_degrees
nodes.description: Compute directed node degree features from coordinate-form edges
nodes.type_signature: (edge_index: NDArray[np.int64], num_nodes: int, mode: str = "out") -> NDArray[np.int64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Summing edge indices using bincount for E edges over N nodes takes O(N + E) time and O(N) space.

nodes.name: pagerank
nodes.description: Compute PageRank centrality scores by damped power iteration
nodes.type_signature: (adjacency: NDArray[np.float64], damping: float = 0.85, max_iter: int = 100, tol: float = 1e-6) -> NDArray[np.float64]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Performing M power iterations of dense matrix-vector multiplication for a graph with N nodes requires O(M * N^2) time and O(N^2) space.

nodes.name: connected_components
nodes.description: Label connected components in a dense adjacency matrix
nodes.type_signature: (adj_matrix: NDArray[np.float64], directed: bool = False) -> tuple[int, NDArray[np.int64]]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Converting the dense N x N matrix to CSR format and finding components via DFS/BFS takes O(N^2) time and space.

nodes.name: skeleton_to_graph
nodes.description: Extract endpoint and junction topology from a 2-D binary skeleton image
nodes.complexity_reasoning: Extracting the skeleton graph topology walks active pixels in a single pass, taking linear time and space relative to the H x W image area.
